Vanra, or Vanra Bergauz, is the subject of the quest Save Vanra. Vanra is  Lora's daughter.

Involvement

Main article: Save Vanra

After meeting Lora and progressing her quest to save Vanra, the party can rescue Vanra from  Auntie Ethel in the Blushing Mermaid. Ethel has eaten Vanra and is planning to let her stew in her belly until she has absorbed enough power to become a hag herself.

Killing Ethel also kills Vanra unless steps are taken to prevent it. One way to do so is to craft the  Hag's Bane using ingredients and a recipe acquired from a safe in Old Garlow's Place. This potion causes Ethel to become  Nauseous and safely throw up Vanra. Alternatively, toggling  Non-Lethal Damage and using unarmed or melee weapon attacks to knock Ethel unconscious allows the party to cut her open and free Vanra.

Vanra is quite traumatized by this experience, quivering and calling for her 'mummy'. After a brief dialogue with the party she runs off to her mother at Lora's House.

All of this only occurs if Ethel was denied access to  Mayrina in Act One. Otherwise, Lora and Vanra are at their house in the Lower City and have little to say other than berating the party for barging into their home.
